name: 95367 · Riverbank, CA
findings: ZIP 95367 (Riverbank) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95367 (Riverbank) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95367 (Riverbank) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 27% of the typical level).
